integrity: The proof uses Burnside's basis theorem, the standard nondegenerate commutator form of an extraspecial group, direct projective counting, and a lexicographic blow-up spectral calculation. A standalone checker verifies the rank-one boundary, strongly regular base parameters, matrix identity, and a full order-32 group instance.
scientific_limitations: The exact blow-up and spectral formulas are for extraspecial finite p-groups.

For rank at least two, equality with the noncommuting graph follows because the group is not two-generated; the additional content is the exact symplectic graph model, spectrum, and rigidity statement.
The full text of the older extraspecial noncommuting-set paper was not available through the inspected public source, leaving a residual bibliographic risk.
title: Extraspecial noncommuting–nongenerating graphs are symplectic blow-ups
